summary: get_or_compute used a truthiness check on the cached value, so falsy values (0, '', [], and also cached None) were recomputed every call. Fixed by reading the raw Redis value and treating only a missing key (raw is None) as a miss. Test suite: 7 passed, 2 skipped -- both Redis tests (including test_get_or_compute_caches_falsy_value) skipped because no Redis server is reachable on localhost:6379, so the change is NOT verified by the test suite. A separate ad-hoc script with an in-memory stub client confirmed 0, '', [], None and a dict are each computed only once.
